decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (EX/12027/01-A, EX/12027/02-A, EX/12027/03-A, Design & Access Statement Received 03/04/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (brickwork and tiles) of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  south-eastern elevation of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alteration and extension of existing conservatory to the rear of the house including a new roof and formation of a gable end to the structure.
